story_sequence.text: `features/<slug>/*.md` is authoritative for normal production and consumption.
Commands and skills must call truth-map resolver before reading truth.
Legacy triptych is not a canonical source in v1.5.2.
`doctor` can rebuild legacy triptych from package truth.
`change` can absorb legacy triptych into package truth.
Missing JSON twins do not block Markdown truth validity.
QA/release/gate use resolver and parser outputs from package truth.
Drift against package truth is reported; package truth remains authority.

artifact_read_model.summary: machine completeness projection is missing, but v1.5.2 package truth and coverage are valid authority

decision_traceability.summary: human requirement truth is carried by the authoritative feature package

coverage_closure.summary: acceptance coverage is parseable from package tests

downgrade_control.summary: legacy completeness projection absence does not downgrade package authority

stage_admission.summary: qa admission uses authoritative package truth

artifact.recovery_reason: implementation evidence exists on earlier revision lineage and must be reconciled through beacon-change without erasing provenance
